description:
Coder-facing BRIDGE guide (the set's coder exception to the non-coder default).

1. 3-column Rosetta table: Standard git task | With beadwork as a coder | The everyday non-coder version.
2. List: what beadwork + AI do that git alone cannot (plain-language operation; signed/timestamped reasoning threads; an agent that reads+synthesizes the whole history / meta-analysis; bw recap cross-repo; dependency/epic + bw ready work-readiness; decision-log shape out of the box).
3. Kicker: coders already have git for code; beadwork earns its place for their NON-code work (decisions, research, side/business/household) — most coders who try it there keep it. No overclaim.
title: G9 — The same tool, three ways (by hand -> with an agent -> non-coder)
